description: Backend foundation: MongoDB models, encrypted credential store, model catalogue repository, provider configuration service, and all 11 REST endpoints in backend/api/v1/model_directory.py. Wires the new router into the v1 aggregator. Seeds 12 catalogue entries. Adds Fernet-based credential encryption to backend/core/secrets.py.
steps: 1. Create backend/models/model_directory.py with three TimestampedModel subclasses: AIModelCatalogue (provider_name, model_id, capability ['tts'|'stt'|'llm'], hosting_mode ['managed_api'|'local_runtime'|'self_hosted'], supported_languages list[str], streaming_supported bool, credential_requirements list[str], setup_requirements str, license_spdx str, commercial_use_allowed bool, free_tier_info dict|None, free_tier_verified_date str|None, pricing_per_minute_usd float|None, doc_url str, model_card_url str|None, implementation_status ['supported'|'experimental'|'unavailable'], notes str|None). ProviderConfiguration (org_id str|None [None=platform], capability str, provider_name str, model_id str, is_active bool, is_fallback bool, voice str|None, language str|None, extra_params dict, last_tested_at datetime|None, last_test_result str|None, last_test_latency_ms int|None, activated_at datetime|None). ProviderCredential (provider_name str, encrypted_value bytes [Fernet], key_hint str [last 4 chars], created_by str, rotated_at datetime|None). All inherit TimestampedModel with id=Field(default_factory=new_id, alias='_id').

2. Create backend/core/secrets.py: CredentialStore class with _key: bytes = Fernet.generate_key() derived from settings.secret_key via SHA-256 (no new env var needed). Methods: encrypt(plaintext: str) -> bytes, decrypt(ciphertext: bytes) -> str, key_hint(plaintext: str) -> str (returns last 4 chars). Never log the key or plaintext. Use from cryptography.fernet import Fernet (already installed via python-jose[cryptography]).

3. Create backend/repositories/model_directory_repo.py with three repository classes: AIModelCatalogueRepo(BaseRepository) — collection 'ai_model_catalogue', find_by_capability, find_by_status, search(query: str) using $regex on provider_name+model_id+notes. ProviderConfigurationRepo(BaseRepository) — collection 'provider_configurations', find_active_for_capability(capability), find_platform_config(capability), upsert_config. ProviderCredentialRepo(BaseRepository) — collection 'provider_credentials', find_by_provider(provider_name), store_credential(provider_name, encrypted_value, key_hint, user_id), rotate_credential, delete_credential. Always return encrypted bytes, never decrypt in the repo.

4. Create backend/services/model_directory_service.py: ModelDirectoryService class taking db: AsyncIOMotorDatabase. Methods: list_catalogue(capability=None, status=None, search=None) — filters catalogue, strips pricing claims older than 90 days with a staleness warning. get_model(model_id) — returns single entry. connect_provider(config_data, credential_plaintext, user: CurrentUser) — encrypts credential, stores ProviderCredential, stores ProviderConfiguration with is_active=False. test_provider(config_id, user: CurrentUser) — reads config + decrypts credential + calls appropriate mock or real adapter (see step 6), records last_test_result + last_test_latency_ms. activate_provider(config_id, user: CurrentUser) — sets is_active=True, deactivates previous active config for same capability, logs audit entry via AuditLogRepository. get_active_config(capability) — returns active ProviderConfiguration. list_credentials(provider_name) — returns list with key_hint only, never encrypted bytes. rotate_credential(provider_name, new_plaintext, user) — creates new ProviderCredential, marks old as rotated. delete_credential(provider_name, user) — removes credential + all configs using that provider. list_configs(capability=None) — lists all ProviderConfiguration records for platform. update_fallback(config_id, fallback_config_id, user) — sets is_fallback chain.

5. Create backend/services/model_test_service.py: ModelTestService with test_tts(provider_name, model_id, credential, voice, language) -> dict, test_stt(provider_name, model_id, credential, language) -> dict, test_llm(provider_name, model_id, credential) -> dict. Each method calls the appropriate adapter with a harmless sample ('Hello, this is a test.' for TTS/LLM; 10-byte silent WAV for STT). Returns {status, latency_ms, sample_output_b64?, error?}. Uses existing SarvamEngine, STTClient, LLMClient constructors with injected credentials. For Ollama: use httpx.AsyncClient GET http://localhost:11434/api/tags to detect runtime reachability; if reachable, POST /api/generate with the specified model and prompt 'Say hello in one sentence.'. For faster-whisper and AI4Bharat stubs: return {status: 'unavailable', error: 'Adapter not yet implemented'} — do not fake success.

6. Add adapter stubs (no new files, extend existing): In backend/audio/tts.py add class AI4BharatTTSEngine(TTSEngine) and class IndicF5Engine(TTSEngine) — both __init__ raise NotImplementedError('AI4Bharat adapter not yet implemented. Status: experimental.'). Add class OllamaTTSEngine(TTSEngine) — __init__ raises NotImplementedError('Ollama TTS not a standard capability. Use LLM capability.'). In backend/audio/stt.py add class FasterWhisperSTT — __init__ raises NotImplementedError('faster-whisper adapter not yet implemented. Status: experimental.'). In backend/agent/llm.py add class OllamaLLMClient — __init__ takes base_url: str = 'http://localhost:11434', model: str = 'llama3.2'. Implements async generate(messages) -> str using httpx.AsyncClient to POST /api/chat. Used by ModelTestService for Ollama testing. These additions must not break existing get_tts_engine(), STTClient, or LLMClient.

7. Create backend/api/v1/model_directory.py with APIRouter(prefix='/model-directory', tags=['model-directory'], dependencies=[Depends(require_platform())]). Endpoints: GET /catalogue?capability=&status=&search= (list catalogue, no credentials returned). GET /catalogue/{model_id} (single entry). POST /configurations (body: ConfigureProviderRequest — provider_name, model_id, capability, credential_plaintext?, voice?, language?, extra_params?, is_fallback?). GET /configurations?capability= (list all). GET /configurations/{config_id} (single, masks credential). POST /configurations/{config_id}/test (test connectivity). POST /configurations/{config_id}/activate (activate+audit). POST /configurations/{config_id}/fallback (body: fallback_config_id). DELETE /configurations/{config_id} (deactivate+audit). GET /credentials/{provider_name} (list hint+metadata only — never encrypted bytes). POST /credentials/{provider_name}/rotate (body: new_plaintext). DELETE /credentials/{provider_name} (audit). Inject CurrentUser via Depends(require_platform('platform_owner','platform_admin')). All write endpoints call audit_repo.log(). Errors: 404 for missing, 400 for incompatible config, 409 for activation of untested config.

8. Register the new router in backend/api/v1/__init__.py: add 'from backend.api.v1 import model_directory' to the import line and 'router.include_router(model_directory.router)' after the provider_ops line. DO NOT modify provider_ops.py.

9. Add MongoDB index declarations in backend/core/db.py (find the existing init_db function and add to it, do not replace): ai_model_catalogue: unique on (provider_name, model_id), index on capability+implementation_status. provider_configurations: index on capability+is_active, index on provider_name. provider_credentials: unique on provider_name. Idempotent (init_db is already called at startup).

10. Create backend/services/model_catalogue_seed.py: async seed_model_catalogue(db) function that upserts 12 AIModelCatalogue entries using find-then-insert idempotency (check by provider_name+model_id). Call from backend/main.py lifespan alongside existing seed functions. Entries — see FEAT-001 catalogue data section below.

POST /api/v1/model-directory/configurations stores config; GET /credentials/{provider} returns key_hint only, never plaintext
POST /api/v1/model-directory/configurations/{id}/test for groq-whisper and groq LLM returns {status:'ok', latency_ms: >0}; for ai4bharat returns {status:'unavailable'}
POST /api/v1/model-directory/configurations/{id}/activate sets is_active=True and creates audit log entry
Credential rotation creates new ProviderCredential and marks old one; delete removes credential and linked configs
All endpoints return 403 for non-platform-admin tokens
seed_model_catalogue is idempotent (second run does not duplicate entries)
All existing backend tests (M1–M40) continue to pass

findings: Implemented successfully. Key findings: (1) backend/models/ is in .gitignore (for ML model binaries) — new Python model file required git add -f. (2) test_m20_post_call.py::test_process_updates_analytics was a pre-existing failure (confirmed by stashing changes and running without them). (3) All 929 other tests pass. (4) 12 routes registered at /api/v1/model-directory/*. (5) Fernet credential encryption working (secrets OK verified). (6) All 12 catalogue seed entries defined. (7) Stubs for AI4BharatTTSEngine, IndicF5Engine, OllamaTTSEngine (tts.py), FasterWhisperSTT (stt.py), OllamaLLMClient (llm.py) added without breaking existing classes.
